changes.summary: Isolated test env: @1mcp/agent 0.38.2 and @modelcontextprotocol/server-everything 2026.8.31 installed with npm --save-exact into a local prefix; no global install, no project source change.

Gateway downstream inventory: everything-stdio (stdio) and everything-http (streamableHttp at 127.0.0.1:3051). Gateway runs serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3050 --external-url https://alvin.tail63d20f.ts.net --enable-config-reload false.
Test-env shim forcing server-everything's streamableHttp listener onto 127.0.0.1 (package binds all interfaces by default); package itself unmodified.
Secret-free AT-001 fixture: gateway_url https://alvin.tail63d20f.ts.net/mcp, protocol versions 2025-11-25/2025-06-18, stdio get-sum(2,3)=5 and http get-sum(40,2)=42.
https://alvin.tail63d20f.ts.net/mcp -> http://127.0.0.1:3050/mcp, tailnet only, only path /mcp proxied. Rollback: tailscale serve reset.
